messages:
Ava: Quick follow-up to the streaming/chat postmortem. We observed repeated partial-response patterns + client-side timeouts in the last two weeks. Need to assign owners, short-term mitigations, and a medium-term plan so this stops recurring.

Leo: I can take the SDK side (resume/reconnect UX). Plan: add a resume token handshake and a client-side capped retry loop (3 attempts) with exponential backoff + jitter. Aim to open PR by 2026-04-08.

Carmen: I'll own server behavior and gateway tuning. Short-term: reduce gateway idle timeout from 50s -> 32s, enable more aggressive keepalives, and implement a soft-truncate detection that emits "partial_detected" metric. Long-term: add explicit trailing partial frame with resume cursor. ETA: design note by 2026-03-30.

Nikhil: I'll handle monitoring and post-deploy verification. Dashboards to add: stream_timeout_rate, partial_payload_count, resume_success_rate, and avg_time_to_recover. Add alert: stream_timeout_rate > 0.4% for 15m. I'll add the panels and a synthetic test that simulates ECONNRESET. Target: dashboards + synthetic by 2026-03-28.

Ava: Good. Short-term mitigations we can roll today: client auto-retry for ECONNRESET & short TCP resets, gateway timeout change, and togglable smaller-chunk mode on server. Carmen, can you add a runtime flag for small_chunk_mode?

Carmen: Yes. We'll introduce feature flag SERVER_SMALL_CHUNK that Ops can toggle per-region. It will also emit a debug log when enabled.

Leo: SDK note: compatibility is key. We'll introduce ResumeToken in the wire protocol and a shim so older servers ignore it. Pseudocode for client reconnect/resume:
```
if (stream.closed && err in [ECONNRESET, TIMEOUT]) {
  for (i=1; i<=3; i++) {
    await sleep(2**i * 100 + jitter());
    connect(headers={Resume-Token: lastSeenToken});
    if (connected && resumed) return success;
  }
  surface_error_to_app();
}
```

Ava: Perfect. Make sure the SDK exposes a boolean for apps to opt into fast-reconnect for idempotent chat.

Nikhil: For verification, tests will simulate partial frames and server-side close after N tokens, then assert client resumes and receives the rest. We'll gate the change behind integration tests in CI.

Carmen: For the trailing frame, proposal: final frame on partial send -> {"type":"partial_end","request_id":"<id>","cursor":"<cursor>"}. Clients can use this to decide immediate resume. Need API review for backward compatibility.

Ava: Who will update ops runbook and incident playbook? Need steps: flip SERVER_SMALL_CHUNK, reduce gateway timeout, run synthetic, and contact eng-oncall.

Nikhil: I'll update the runbook with exact steps and add an Ops checklist. Will also include rollback steps if enabling small_chunk causes regressions. Target: runbook update by 2026-03-27.

Leo: I'll add SDK integration tests and a short migration note for customers. Recommended guidance: enable SDK patch via feature flag, customers on older SDKs should be advised to upgrade when we ship server trailing frames.

Carmen: Scheduling: design doc for trailing frame + keepalive tuning by 2026-03-30, implement across two sprints, and feature flag for small_chunk ready in 1 sprint.

Ava: Ownership summary: Leo = SDK resume/retry & tests (PR 2026-04-08), Carmen = server trailing frame + small_chunk flag + gateway tuning (design 2026-03-30), Nikhil = dashboards, synthetics, runbook update (2026-03-27). I'll coordinate cross-team rollouts and customer comms.

OpsBot: Created epic RT-4399 "streaming stability: resume tokens & partial-response handling" and linked to incident board.

Nikhil: I'll attach the synthetic test results here after I run the first simulation.

Leo: Example resume token exchange for API changelog:
```
Client -> Server: {"start":true, "last_token":"abc123"}
Server -> Client: {"resume_ok":true, "cursor":"cursor42"}
```

Carmen: Also adding an internal metric partial_frame_duration_ms so we can detect long-running partial frames that correlate with timeouts.

Ava: Timeline expectation: short-term mitigations (timeout + small_chunk + client retry) -> 1 week, SDK + server resumable protocol -> 4-6 weeks. We'll treat recurring incidents as P1 until rates drop under alert threshold.

Nikhil: I'll schedule a weekly incident-pattern review to catch recurrences and surface them to postmortem board.

Leo: Creating JIRA tasks: RT-4401 (SDK resume), RT-4402 (SDK tests), RT-4403 (customer migration note).

Carmen: JIRA: RT-4404 (server trailing frame), RT-4405 (small_chunk flag), RT-4406 (gateway keepalive tuning).

Ava: I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and link the JIRA items. If anyone hits a blocker, post here and I'll escalate. Reopening for updates after implementation milestones. :white_check_mark:
